subject: info-ds
title: (R)INFO.DS.------AF.DY.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-30, on the page where Braxton argues that spectacle-diversion 'extends to source transfer' — that the actual realness of spectacle-diversion functions as the phenomenon allowing style transference, with style being indebted to world group influences (Indian religion, Asian dress, women's movement use of black functionalism, etc.). (R)INFO-DS — the reality of information dissemination — is crossed with AF-DY (affinity dynamics): the question is what real dissemination does to affinity dynamics in a culture that has institutionalized spectacle-diversion. (C)SPT-D (the concept of spectacle dynamics), (C)ST (the concept of style), and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) feed the subject. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and SOC-RT (social reality) are upstream constituting forces. The crossing produces AF-DY, which fans into VT-DY (vibrational dynamics), POST (postulation), INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), and STF (source transfer). Structural argument: real information dissemination, when routed through the spectacle-style apparatus of a culture, produces affinity dynamics that flow outward to four parallel cultural-vibrational outputs. STF (source transfer) as the terminal node registers Braxton's diagnostic claim: the dissemination apparatus IS the source-transfer mechanism by which spectacle absorbs style from outside its essence continuum.
